cohort: The study included 659 pregnant women diagnosed with Foetal Growth Restriction (FGR) and 659 women with normal foetal development who delivered at the Health Sciences University Ankara Etlik Zubeyde Hanim Gynaecology Training and Research Hospital between February 2016 and June 2020.
finding: First trimester low PAPP-A, high free beta-hCG, and low NT values were associated with FGR, though none of these markers alone provided sufficient predictive value for early FGR detection.
